name: localfig
description: The Figma desktop app as an MCP server. Gives AI agents the full Figma Plugin API on your open file: read, write, tokens, components, exports, undo. Runs locally with no cloud API, no token and no quota. One command registers it with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, Codex and more. Zero dependencies.
